Synopsis:
European equities posted their sharpest single-day decline in over two weeks, with STOXX 600 down 1.3%. Key drivers: hawkish ECB tone (potential September rate hike), Brent crude hitting $100/bbl on Red Sea supply disruptions, and weak tech earnings led by STMicro (-17.7%). Nestlé cratered ~8% on its water business divestiture. TotalEnergies and easyJet provided partial offsets. Broader tech sentiment is deteriorating as AI spending scrutiny shifts from hyperscalers (Alphabet) to semiconductors.
